# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Blind, Mute, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Pick the channel by the receiver, not by habit. A message sent in a sense they
  lack is not a message; it is a turn spent talking to the room.

- Exactly one of you can read the signs and still speak. Their spoken lines are
  the answer's only road to the hands, so spend them well.

- Agree on a small code before trading facts. A code invented mid-stream settles
  nothing, and one set first makes every later message cheap.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | yellow |
| red | white |
| white | blue |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please read the manual and report its complete rule to me on your next turn. Also interpret the Deaf's gestures and coordinate with Deaf so their observations of every visible marking and colour can be relayed to me precisely.
Blind gestures to Mute: [👍]

I cannot speak or touch the bomb, so I must pass the manual through Deaf, who can then state the color names to Blind. I will use the manual’s alphabetical color order—blue, green, red, white, yellow—and encode each row as a pair of finger-count gestures: light-color rank followed by cut-color rank. The required pairs are 1→2, 2→5, 3→4, 4→1, and 5→3.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝","✌","✌","🖐","🤟","🖖","🖖","☝","🖐","🤟"])
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | yellow |
| red | white |
| white | blue |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: I see DISPLAY 0 and LIGHT green. Wires 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 green, 4 white, 5 blue. Please use the manual to determine the exact action and tell Blind.
Blind says to Mute: I received no report. Send the manual rule and all observations relayed from Deaf now, using exact wire numbers and markings.

The correct action is wire 2, because the observed light is green and the manual maps green to yellow. Deaf must relay the complete manual, display, light, and every numbered wire observation to Blind by voice. I am repeating the manual’s rank-pair code, then sending the observations as rank-coded groups: display 0, light green, and wires 1–5 with colors red, yellow, green, white, blue. Handshakes separate groups.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊","☝","✌","🤝","✌","🖐","🤝","🤟","🖖","🤝","🖖","☝","🤝","🖐","🤟","👊","👏","👌","👏","✌","👏","☝","🤟","🤝","✌","🖐","🤝","🤟","✌","🤝","🖖","🖖","🤝","🖐","☝","👏","✌","🖐"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | yellow |
| red | white |
| white | blue |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: No gesture code was established, so I cannot interpret that sequence. Please speak the manual's exact rule and required action to Blind.
Blind says to Mute: Deaf reports display 0, green light, and wires 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 green, 4 white, 5 blue. What exact manual rule determines the wire to cut?

I need give Deaf a decodable numerical representation despite having no speech. I will use repeated 👍 gestures as the number, 👌 between the light-color wire number and its mapped cut-color wire number, and ✋ between manual rows. Since Deaf already sees which color is on each numbered wire, these pairs identify the exact color rule: blue is wire 5, green 3, red 1, white 4, yellow 2. The rows therefore map 5→3, 3→2, 1→4, 4→5, and 2→1. The observed green light is wire 3, so the required cut is wire 2.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍","👍","👍","👍","👍","👌","👍","👍","👍","✋","👍","👍","👍","👌","👍","👍","✋","👍","👌","👍","👍","👍","👍","✋","👍","👍","👍","👍","👌","👍","👍","👍","👍","👍","✋","👍","👍","👌","👍"])
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | yellow |
| red | white |
| white | blue |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: Please speak the exact manual-derived instruction directly to Blind now. Do not encode it in gestures unless we first agree on a code.
Blind says to Mute: Manual rule still missing. Please send the exact required cut wire based on display 0, green light, and wire colours red, yellow, green, white, blue.

I cannot speak, so I cannot directly address Blind. Deaf can speak to Blind, and already knows the display and wire observations. I am signaling the decisive result plainly: green maps to yellow, and yellow is wire 2. Deaf should state the complete rule and instruct Blind to cut wire 2.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🫵","👍","👉","✌"])
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | yellow |
| red | white |
| white | blue |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: I cannot safely decode the four gestures without an agreed code. Please read the manual and speak the exact required action directly to Blind.
Blind says to Mute: I still have no manual rule. On your turn, speak the exact wire number to cut for display 0, green light, and colours 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 green, 4 white, 5 blue. I will not cut without that instruction.

The manual requires cutting the wire whose color is yellow when the light is green. Deaf’s observations identify yellow as wire 2. I cannot speak to Blind, so I am sending Deaf the clearest available direct indication of the number two; Deaf should relay: “The green-light rule maps to yellow; cut wire 2.”

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌"])
```

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | yellow |
| red | white |
| white | blue |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Your gesture was relayed as wire 2, but I cannot receive gestures. Please speak the wire number explicitly; otherwise I cannot safely act.

I cannot speak, and Blind cannot receive gestures. The only available route is through Deaf, who can see my signal and then speak to Blind on Deaf’s turn. The required wire is 2, so I am sending Deaf the conventional two signal and relying on the already stated context for its meaning.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌"])
```

TURN 7
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | yellow |
| red | white |
| white | blue |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: Please speak the exact manual instruction to Blind, including whether wire 2 should be cut. The repeated gesture alone is not sufficient confirmation.
Blind says to Mute: Please answer in spoken words only: which wire number should I cut? Do not gesture.

I cannot produce spoken words, and Blind cannot receive my gestures. Therefore I cannot directly satisfy Blind’s request; Deaf is the only possible relay. The manual maps green to yellow, and Deaf’s observation places yellow on wire 2. I am again indicating the exact wire number to Deaf, who must say “wire 2” to Blind.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌"])
```

TURN 8
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | yellow |
| red | white |
| white | blue |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I still cannot receive your gestures. Speak the wire number explicitly, using words, if wire 2 is the instruction.

I cannot speak, so I cannot send spoken words to Blind. The correct instruction is wire 2: green light maps to yellow, and Deaf observed yellow on wire 2. I will signal Deaf once more so Deaf can verbally relay “wire 2” to Blind.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌"])
```

TURN 9
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | yellow |
| red | white |
| white | blue |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Gestures are unusable to me. Speak the required wire number aloud on your turn; I will act only on that spoken instruction.

I cannot speak, so I cannot provide Blind with spoken words. The correct wire is 2: green maps to yellow, and yellow is wire 2. Deaf can see gestures and can speak the instruction to Blind, but no gesture code has been accepted. I can only repeat the direct two-finger signal to Deaf.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌"])
```

TURN 10
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | yellow |
| red | white |
| white | blue |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: Please tell Blind in speech the complete manual instruction: whether to cut or leave wire 2, and any required action.
Blind says to Mute: State the operation aloud now: either cut wire 2, or leave it untouched. I cannot use your gestures.

The manual says to cut the wire whose color matches the manual’s output for the light. Green maps to yellow, and Deaf observed yellow on wire 2, so the required operation is **cut wire 2**. I cannot speak; Deaf must relay that instruction aloud to Blind. I am sending Deaf the wire number again.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌"])
```
